# Private Chat Server

This microservice is very simple private chat server. 
When deployed, it can be used for simple text communications between connected users.

## 1. Database model
Use postresql relational database. Database name is chat-server.
Use UUIDs for every as unique identifier for every entity.

### Table users
* id - uuid, primary key, autogenerated
* login - unique, string - user's login
* first_name - string
* last_name - string
* active - boolean - inactive user can't login
* time_zone - string
* role - string, enum: ADMIN | USER 
* created_at - timestamp with time zone 
* password_hash - string

### Table tokens
* id - uuid, primary key, autogenerated
* token_hash - string 
* owner - user_id, foreign key
* expires_at - timestamp with time zone

### Table contacts
* id - uuid, primary key, autogenerated
* owner - user_id, foreign key
* user_id - user_id, foreign key 

### Table chats
* id - uuid, primary key, autogenerated
* name - string
* created_at - timestamp with time zone
* owner - user_id, foreign key
* last_active - timestamp with time zone

### Table chats_users
* id - primary key, autogenerated
* chat_id - uuid, foreign key 
* user_id - uuid, foreign key

### Table messages
* id - uuid, primary key, autogenerated
* time_stamp - timestamp with time zone, millisecond precision
* user_id - uuid, foreign key - author of the message
* chat_id - uuid, foreign key - chat that this message belongs to
* message - string - massage body
* edited - boolean - was edited or not

## 2. REST API
### Login
Get access token
```
POST   /v1/tokens/login
Authorization: none
Request Body: { "login": "user1", "password": "*******" }
Response 200: { "access-token": "uuidr-andom-opaque-token", "role": "ADMIN", "expiresAt": "timestamp", "status" : "ok" }
Response 400: { "status" : "failed" } 
```

### Check token
Introspect access token
```
GET    /v1/tokens/check
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 200: { "active": true, "role": "ADMIN", "expiresAt": "timestamp", "status" : "ok" }
Response 400: { "status" : "failed" } 
```

### Invalidate token
Logout action, always returns 200
```
POST   /v1/tokens/logout
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 200: { "status" : "ok" }
```

### Create new User
Only ADMIN role, create new user
```
POST   /v1/users
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "login": "user1", "firstName": "john", "lastName": "doe", "timezone": "UTC", "role": "USER", "password": "*******" }
Response 200: { "id": "uuid" }
```

### Update user's data
Only ADMIN role may update other users. User may update own user data. Only admin may change user's role and active status.
```
PUT    /v1/users/{user-id}
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "firstName": "john", "lastName": "doe", "timezone": "UTC", "role": "USER", "password": "*******", "active": true }
Response 202: 
```

### List users
List all users in the system. Only ADMIN role.
```
GET    /v1/users
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 200: [ 
  { "id": "uuid", "login": "user1", "firstName": "john", "lastName": "doe", "timezone": "UTC", "role": "USER" }
] 
```

### Get single user data
Get data doe particular user by user's uuid. Any user can see other user data as long as provided uuid is in user's contact list.
```
GET    /v1/users/{user-id}
Response 200: { "id": "uuid", "login": "user1", "firstName": "john", "lastName": "doe", "timezone": "UTC", "role": "USER" }
```

### Get self user data
Get user data for user which token belongs to.
```
GET    /v1/users/self
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 200: { "id": "uuid", "login": "user1", "firstName": "john", "lastName": "doe", "timezone": "UTC", "role": "USER" }
```

### Activate user
Activate previously inactive user. Only ADMIN roles.
```
POST   /v1/users/{user-id}/activate
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 202: 
```

### Deactivate user
Deactivate previously active user. Only ADMIN roles.
```
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
POST   /v1/users/{user-id}/deactivate
Response 202: 
```

### Create new user contact
Create contact for user-id. contactId is userId of other user in the system. 
```
POST   /v1/contacts/create
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "contactId": "uuid" }
Response 202: 
```

### Remove user contact
Remove contact for user-id. contactId is userId of other user in the system.
```
POST   /v1/contacts/remove
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "contactId": "uuid" }
Response 202: 
```

### Get list of chats
List all chats owned by this user or where this user member of the chat. All roles.
```
GET   /v1/chats
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 200: [
   { "id": "uuid", "name": "name", "createdAt": "timestamp", "owner": "uuid" }
]
```

### Get chat by uuid
Get chat by uuid, user can see only chats they own or are members of. All roles.
```
GET   /v1/chats/{chat-id}
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 200: { "id": "uuid", "name": "name", "createdAt": "timestamp", "owner": "uuid", "lastActive": "timestamp" }
```

### Create chat
Create new chat and invite users. All roles. Only users in contact list may be invited.
```
POST  /v1/chats
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "name": "chat name", "newMembers": [ "uuid1", "uuid2" ] }
Response 201:
```

### Update chat
Update chat data. Only owner of the chat or ADMIN can do that. If user is updating own chat, only users in contact list may be added.
```
PUT   /v1/chats/{chat-id}
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "name": "new name", "newMembers": [ "uuid1", "uuid2" ], "removedMembers": [ "uuid2" ] }
Response 202:
```

### Get all messages for a chat
Get all messages for a chat. Only owners or members of the chat are allowed to see the messages.
```
GET   /v1/chats/{chat-id}/messages
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Response 200: [
  { "id": "uuid", "timestamp": "timestamp", "userId": "uuid", "message": "message", "edited": false } 
]
```

### Post new message to a chat
Post new message to a chat. Only owners or members of the chat are allowed to post new the messages.
```
POST  /v1/chats/{chat-id}/messages
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "message": "message" }
Response 202:
```

### Edit message in a chat
Edit message in a chat. Only owners or members of the chat are allowed to edit own messages in the chat.
```
PUT   /v1/chats/{chat-id}/messages/{message-id}
Authorization: 'Bearer <token>'
Request Body: { "message": "message" }
Response 202:
```

## 3. Backend
* Springboot 4 , Java 25, gradle, single monolithic runtime
* Data access layer - Spring Data, JDBC templates
* REST APIs - Spring REST, Security: Bearer opaque tokens. 
* Backend project is located in separate subfolder `chat-backend`
* Testing - Junit + Testcontainers, avoid mocking as much as possible. 

## 4. Single page UI
* React + TypeScript + Vite + Mantine
* Single page layout with path routing (bookmarkable links).
* Web UI project is located in separate subfolder `chat-webui`
 
## Deployment
* docker-compose stack containing docker containers below
* `chat-database` - postgewsql single node database server on port 5432
* `chat-backend` - docker image, REST API on port 8080
* `chat-webui` - docker image, Web Server exposes UI on port 8081

## 5. Features & Requirements

### Roles
* ADMIN - can create users, can deactivate users, can create chat, can write messages, can edit own messages
* USER - can create chat, can write messages, can edit own messages
* Role is assigned to user when user is created.
* Only ADMIN can change user roles.

### Users
* First ADMIN user is created in the database manually.
* ADMIN user may create new users or update any user data.
* User can update only own user data.
* User ID and login can't be updated. 
* User can't be deleted, only set inactive by ADMIN.

### Contacts
* Each user can get other user's contact data in user knows uuid of other user.
* Uuid of other user is invitation for contact.
* User can see only users that are listed in user's contacts.

### Tokens
* Each user must get opaque access token to login
* opaque access token is random uuid
* opaque access tokens are hashed before stored in the database
* one user may have one or more valid opaque access tokens
* expired tokens are removed from database
* token is invalid if expires or is removed from database

### Chats
* Each user may create new chat and is owner of that chat.
* User may add other user in own contact list to the chat.
* User can see own chats and chats where user is a member.
* User may post message into a chat.
* Messages in chat are ordered by a timestamp.
* User may edit own message in the chat.
* Message belongs to a chat.
* All members of the chat can see all messages in that chat, including history.
* Users may be added and removed to/from a chat.
* Massages are not deleted.
* Chats are not deleted.
